_comment: The corpus round reads sources that live outside this repository. Nothing
here assumes a particular checkout layout: the pinned commits are named,
and scripts/bootstrap_corpus.sh obtains them into a directory you choose.
Every commit is a 40-character SHA. A reviewer who runs the bootstrap gets
byte-identical sources to the ones the published evidence was produced
from, and a reviewer who does not gets an exact command rather than a
